name: Isosurface Propagation from Seed Cells
aliases: Seed Set Propagation for Contour Extraction
definition: A technique that combines geometric decomposition and span space aspects, starting extraction from a set of seed cells and propagating through neighboring cells.
summary: Isosurface Propagation from Seed Cells extracts surfaces by traversing only neighbor cells from a seed set, avoiding full volume visits to efficiently handle sparse isosurfaces.
